registering_session: S70, pre-score, operator review corrections only
purpose: Record four bounded pre-score corrections and one roadmap refinement found in the operator's S70 review: (1) the randomly initialised LoRA factors are seeded and their initial state is hashed into the arm receipt; (2) a difficulty-weighted SFT control arm isolates the preference objective from the weighting mechanism; (3) the sizing smoke is traced and the trace overhead is measured; (4) MATH-500 and full MATH are two evaluation scales of the same test set, not independent instruments; (5) the BREAD roadmap item is defined by a measurable decision and four corpus gaps are recorded. No objective, primary arm, hyperparameter, budget, cadence, selection rule, adoption gate or win bar changes.

registration.rule: not edited; the primary arm, training flags, selection rule and win bar are unchanged

amendment_1.rule: the weight-realisation rule is unchanged; only the MATH instrument wording is corrected

adapter_initialisation.defect: LoRALinear draws lora_A with kaiming_uniform_ from the global torch RNG; no seed was applied immediately before install_lora, and the pair-order seed 6900 is a different random.Random stream
adapter_initialisation.fix: preference.install_lora accepts seed and seeds random, numpy when importable, and torch/CUDA immediately before the factors are drawn

evidence.digest_over: name, dtype, shape and bytes of every lora_A and lora_B in named_modules order

superseded_runs.reason: the pre-fix receipts cannot prove their initial adapter state

matched_sft_weighting.loss: sum_i w_i CE_i / mean_w on the chosen continuations
matched_sft_weighting.mean_w: the corpus mean positive weight, the same denominator the preference objective uses
matched_sft_weighting.effective_set: identical to the preference arm (drop w <= 0 before budgeting)
matched_sft_weighting.status: additional control arm 4; it does not change the primary win bar, the calibration-selection rule, or which arm is primary

trace_overhead.defect: the sizing smoke was untraced while the arms run with --trace-out
trace_overhead.fix: the sizing smoke is traced; a paired untraced smoke measures the overhead
trace_overhead.arm_limit_basis: max(1.5 * traced peak_reserved, traced peak_reserved + 1) = 15.83 GiB, rounded up to 16g; SELVEDGE_CPUS=8, SELVEDGE_PIDS=1024, SELVEDGE_TMP=2g

math_instrument_interpretation.defect: docs/S69-AMENDMENT-1.md and its JSON called MATH-500 and the 5,000-problem full MATH two independent instruments
math_instrument_interpretation.correction: they are two evaluation scales of the same MATH test set; MATH-500 is a 500-problem subset of the 5,000-problem set, so their paired intervals are correlated
math_instrument_interpretation.consequence: requiring both intervals above zero is a resolution requirement (the larger scale reduces sampling noise; the smaller is the historical comparison), not independent replication

bread_refinement.definition: a decision whose intervention measurably changes downstream correctness, identified by paired do/undo continuations from the same state; wording-only divergence is explicitly rejected as a candidate
added_corpus_gaps: adaptive K on uncertain and all-failure problems
student-generated successful alternatives as chosen-side candidates, not only teacher continuations
teacher coverage for the all-failure problems that produced no recovery pair
the recorded structural limitation that at K = 4 the weight w = p(1-p) takes only three distinct values, including zero

unchanged_by_this_amendment: the objective functional form: -log sigmoid(beta * [(s+ - s-) - (r+ - r-)])
mean token-length normalization of sequence log-probabilities
LoRA rank 64, alpha 32, every text-tower linear layer except the output head, base frozen
the identical-effective-problem-set rule and the w <= 0 drop for the preference arm and the SFT controls
the recovery arm's matched mean positive weight
calibration-only selection: highest MATH-cal, tie-break higher GSM8K-cal then earlier cadence
the MMLU-cal retention filter and the adoption gate
the win bar: both MATH scales' paired 95% intervals above zero; GSM8K and MMLU point delta and interval lower bound not worse than -1.0
the one-shot test rule and the no-enlargement clause
the frozen reference identity (the S67 soup champion)
